Meanwhile, the calculations show that the probability of occurrence of ψ(zi, j) is generally above 70% when the cumulative probability range is at range of 0.2–0.9.

Under the condition of 10%~90% cumulative probability irregularity, the longitudinal length of the track slab required for damage initiation is between 820~890 mm, and only 580 mm under 99% cumulative probability.

The results show that when the track structure is intact, the longitudinal and transverse tensile stress levels of the track slab under each cumulative probability irregularity state are low, and the linear elastic model can be used to simplify the calculation.
